units.en: Shi Wenqing and Shen Keqing won favor through flattery, monopolized power, and Zai grew still more distant.
units.literal: It happened that Shi Wenqing and Shen Keqing through fawning and favoritism were close and cherished, monopolizing the balance of power, while Zai grew still more distant.

units.zh: 文慶等因共譖縡受高驪使金，後主收縡下獄。
units.en: Wenqing and the others then slandered Zai for taking gold from a Goguryeo envoy; Houzhu had him arrested and imprisoned.
units.literal: Wenqing and the others therefore together slandered Zai for receiving gold from a Goguryeo envoy; Houzhu arrested Zai and put him in prison.

units.zh: 縡素剛，因憤恚，乃於獄中上書曰：「夫君人者，恭事上帝，子愛下民，省嗜慾，遠諂佞，未明求衣，日旰忘食，是以澤被區宇，慶流子孫。
units.en: Zai was by nature unyielding; in rage he submitted a memorial from prison: "A ruler should respectfully serve Heaven, love the people, curb desire, keep far from flatterers, rise at unclear dawn and forget food at sundown—then grace covers the realm and blessing reaches his heirs.
units.literal: Zai by nature was firm; in indignant rage he thereupon submitted a memorial from prison, saying: "The ruler ought to respectfully serve the Supreme Lord, love and cherish the people below, reduce cravings and desires, keep far from flattery and favoritism, at unclear dawn seek clothing, at sundown forget food—thereby grace covers the realm and blessing flows to sons and grandsons.

units.zh: 陛下頃來酒色過度，不虔郊廟之神，專媚淫昏之鬼；
units.en: Your Majesty of late has gone to excess in wine and sex, neglects the spirits of the suburban altars, and dotes only on ghosts of lewd darkness;
units.literal: Your Majesty of late has passed bounds in wine and sex, is not reverent toward the spirits of the suburban altars, and dotes on the ghosts of lewd darkness alone;

units.zh: 小人在側，宦豎弄權，惡忠直若仇讎，視生民如草芥；
units.en: petty men stand at your side, eunuchs toy with power, you hate the loyal and upright as enemies, and treat the people like grass;
units.literal: petty men are at your side, palace eunuchs toy with power, you hate the loyal and straight as enemies, and regard living people as grass and stubble;

units.zh: 後宮曳綺繡，廄馬餘菽粟，百姓流離，殭尸蔽野；
units.en: the rear palace trails brocade while stable horses leave grain unused, the people wander homeless, and stiff corpses cover the wilds;
units.literal: in the rear palace trailing brocade and embroidery, in the stables horses leave grain and millet surplus, while the people wander displaced and stiff corpses cover the wilds;

units.zh: 貨賄公行，帑藏損耗，神怒民怨，眾叛親離。
units.en: bribes run openly, the treasury drains, spirits rage and the people resent, the masses rebel and kin turn away.
units.literal: bribes go openly, the treasury is drained, the spirits are angry and the people resentful, the masses rebel and kin turn away.

units.zh: 恐東南王氣，自斯而盡。」
units.en: I fear the kingly qi of the southeast ends here."
units.literal: I fear the kingly qi of the southeast ends from this."

units.zh: 書奏，後主大怒。
units.en: When the memorial arrived Houzhu was furious.
units.literal: When the memorial was submitted Houzhu was greatly enraged.

units.zh: 頃之，意稍解，遣使謂縡曰：「我欲赦卿，卿能改過不？」
units.en: Before long his anger cooled somewhat; he sent an envoy to tell Zai, "I wish to pardon you—can you reform your faults?"
units.literal: Before long his mind eased somewhat; he sent an envoy to tell Zai: "I wish to pardon you—can you reform your faults?"

units.zh: 縡對曰：「臣心如面，臣面可改，則臣心可改。」
units.en: Zai replied, "My mind is like my face; if my face can change, then my mind can change."
units.literal: Zai replied: "My mind is like my face; if my face can change, then my mind can change."

units.zh: 後主於是益怒，令宦者李善慶窮治其事，[7]遂賜死獄中，時年五十五。
units.en: Houzhu then grew still angrier and ordered the eunuch Li Shanqing to investigate to the end, [7] and Zai was ordered to die in prison, aged fifty-five.
units.literal: Houzhu thereupon grew still more angry and ordered the eunuch Li Shanqing to investigate the matter to the end, [7] and Zai was granted death in prison, aged fifty-five.

units.zh: 有集十卷行於世。
units.en: A collection of writings in ten scrolls circulated after his death.
units.literal: He had a collection of writings in ten scrolls circulating in the world.

units.zh: 時有吳興章華，字仲宗，家世農夫，至華獨好學，與士君子遊處，頗覽經史，善屬文。
units.en: At the time Zhang Hua of Wuxing, styled Zhongzong, came from a farming family—he alone loved learning, kept company with scholars, read widely in the classics and histories, and wrote well.
units.literal: At the time there was Zhang Hua of Wuxing, styled Zhongzong; his family for generations were farmers—Hua alone loved learning, associated with gentlemen and scholars, and broadly read the classics and histories, skilled at composition.

units.zh: 侯景之亂，乃遊嶺南，居羅浮山寺，專精習業。
units.en: During Hou Jing's turmoil he fled to Lingnan, lived at Luofu Mountain Temple, and devoted himself to study.
units.literal: In the turmoil of Hou Jing he then traveled to Lingnan, lived at Luofu Mountain Temple, and devoted himself to study.

units.zh: 歐陽頠為廣州刺史，署為南海太守。
units.en: Ouyang Wei, inspector of Guangzhou, appointed him administrator of Nanhai.
units.literal: Ouyang Wei was inspector of Guangzhou and appointed him Administrator of Nanhai.

units.zh: 及歐陽紇敗，乃還京師。
units.en: When Ouyang He was defeated he returned to the capital.
units.literal: When Ouyang He was defeated he then returned to the capital.

units.zh: 太建中，高宗使吏部侍郎蕭引喻廣州刺史馬靖，令入子為質，引奏華與俱行。
units.en: In the Taijian era, Emperor Xuan sent vice minister of personnel Xiao Yin to instruct Guangzhou inspector Ma Jing to send his son as hostage; Yin memorialized that Hua should accompany the mission.
units.literal: In the Taijian era, Emperor Xuan sent vice minister of personnel Xiao Yin to instruct Guangzhou inspector Ma Jing to send in his son as hostage; Yin memorialized that Hua should accompany him.

units.zh: 使還，而高宗崩。
units.en: When the mission returned, Emperor Xuan had died.
units.literal: When the mission returned, Emperor Xuan had died.

units.zh: 後主即位，朝臣以華素無伐閱，競排詆之，乃除大市令，既雅非所好，乃辭以疾，鬱鬱不得志。
units.en: When Houzhu took the throne, court gentlemen—Hua had no record of merit—competed to slander him; he was made director of the great market. That post ill suited him; he pleaded illness and resigned, depressed and thwarted.
units.literal: When Houzhu took the throne the court gentlemen, because Hua by nature had no meritorious background, all competed to slander him; he was therefore made director of the great market. As it was utterly not to his liking, he pleaded illness and resigned, depressed and without achieving his aim.

units.zh: 禎明初，上書極諫，其大略曰：「昔高祖南平百越，北誅逆虜；
units.en: Early in Zhenming he submitted a memorial of fierce remonstrance, saying in gist: "In the past the Founder pacified the Hundred Yue in the south and punished the rebel captives in the north;
units.literal: Early in Zhenming he submitted a memorial of extreme remonstrance; its general purport said: "In the past the Founder southward pacified the Hundred Yue and northward punished the rebellious captives;

units.zh: 世祖東定吳會，西破王琳；
units.en: Emperor Wen eastward settled Wu and Kuaiji and westward broke Wang Lin;
units.literal: Emperor Wen eastward settled Wu and Kuaiji and westward broke Wang Lin;

units.zh: 高宗克復淮南，辟地千里：三祖之功，亦至勤矣。
units.en: Emperor Xuan recovered Huainan and opened land for a thousand li—the merit of the three ancestors was utmost diligence.
units.literal: Emperor Xuan recovered Huainan and opened land for a thousand li—the merit of the three ancestors was also utmost diligence.

units.zh: 陛下即位，于今五年，不思先帝之艱難，不知天命之可畏，溺於嬖寵，惑於酒色，祠七廟而不出，拜妃嬪而臨軒，老臣宿將，棄之草莽，諂佞讒邪，昇之朝廷。
units.en: Your Majesty has reigned five years without remembering the former emperor's hardships or fearing Heaven's mandate, drowning in favorites and delusion of wine and sex, sacrificing at the seven temples yet not going out, bowing to consorts yet holding court, casting old ministers and veteran generals to the wilds and raising flatterers and slanderers.
units.literal: Your Majesty has reigned now five years, not thinking of the former emperor's hardships, not knowing that Heaven's mandate is to be feared, drowning in favorites, deluded by wine and sex, sacrificing at the seven temples yet not going out, bowing to consorts yet holding court, old ministers and veteran generals cast to the wild grass, flatterers and slanderous villains raised into the court.

units.zh: 今疆埸日蹙，隋軍壓境，陛下如不改絃易張，臣見麋鹿復遊於姑蘇臺矣。」
units.en: Now the frontier shrinks daily and Sui troops press the border—if Your Majesty does not change course, I see deer roaming the Gusu Terrace again."
units.literal: Now the frontier daily narrows and Sui troops press the border—if Your Majesty does not change the string and ease the bow, I see deer again roaming the Gusu Terrace."

units.zh: 書奏，後主大怒，即日命斬之。
units.en: When the memorial arrived Houzhu was furious and ordered him beheaded that same day.
units.literal: When the memorial was submitted Houzhu was greatly enraged and that same day ordered him beheaded.

units.zh: 史臣曰：蕭濟、陸瓊，俱以才學顯著，顧野王博極群典，傅縡聰警特達，並一代之英靈矣。
units.en: The historiographer says: Xiao Ji and Lu Qiong both shone for talent and learning; Gu Yewang mastered the canon; Fu Zai was brilliantly sharp—all spirits of an age.
units.literal: The historiographer says: Xiao Ji and Lu Qiong both for talent and learning were illustrious; Gu Yewang's learning exhausted the canon; Fu Zai was sharp-witted and outstanding—all spirits of an age.

units.zh: 然縡不能循道進退，遂寘極網，悲夫！
units.en: Yet Zai could not advance and withdraw by the Way and so fell into the utmost net—pitiable!
units.literal: Yet Zai could not follow the Way in advancing and withdrawing and therefore fell into the utmost net—pitiable!

units.zh: 沖母，梁武帝妹新安穆公主，卒於齊世，武帝以沖偏孤，深所鍾愛。
units.en: Chong's mother was Princess Xin'an Mu, a sister of Emperor Wu of Liang. She died in Qi times, and the emperor, seeing that Chong had been left partially orphaned, doted on him.
units.literal: Chong's mother was Princess Xin'an Mu, sister of Emperor Wu of Liang; she died in Qi times, and the Emperor, because Chong was a lone orphan, cherished him deeply.

units.zh: 按梁武帝即位後，追尊其父為文皇帝。
units.en: After Liang Wudi's accession he honored his father posthumously as Emperor Wen.
units.literal: According to the note, after Emperor Wu of Liang took the throne he posthumously honored his father as Emperor Wen.

units.zh: 王沖傳言其母為梁武帝妹新安穆公主，與此合。
units.en: Wang Chong's biography says his mother was Liang Wudi's sister Princess Xin'an Mu, which matches.
units.literal: The biography of Wang Chong says his mother was Emperor Wu of Liang's sister, Princess Xin'an Mu—this agrees.

units.zh: 王沖 王通弟勱 袁敬兄子樞
units.en: Wang Chong; Wang Tong, younger brother Mo; Yuan Jing, nephew Shu
units.literal: Wang Chong; Wang Tong, younger brother Mo; Yuan Jing, nephew Shu

units.zh: [2]琳，齊代娶梁武帝妹義興長公主，有子九人，嵭知名。
units.en: Lin, in Qi times, married Emperor Wu of Liang's sister, Princess of Yixing long; he had nine sons, all of whom won notice.
units.literal: Lin, in Qi times married Emperor Wu of Liang's sister Princess of Yixing long, had nine sons, and all became renowned.

units.zh: 大同末，梁武帝謁園陵，道出朱方，勱隨例迎候，队勱令從輦側，所經山川，莫不顧問，勱隨事應對，咸有故實。
units.en: Near the end of Datong, Emperor Wu of Liang visited the imperial tombs by way of Zhufang; Mo met him as custom required. The emperor ordered Mo to ride beside the carriage; at every hill and stream he asked questions, and Mo answered each with historical precedent.
units.literal: Near the end of Datong, Emperor Wu of Liang visited the imperial tombs; the route passed through Zhufang; Mo greeted him per custom; the Emperor ordered Mo to ride beside the carriage; every mountain and river passed, the Emperor inquired; Mo answered each matter with historical precedent.

units.zh: 漢則馬遷、蕭望，晉則裴楷、張華。
units.en: In Han there were Sima Qian and Xiao Wangzhi; in Jin there were Pei Kai and Zhang Hua.
units.literal: In Han there were Sima Qian and Xiao Wangzhi; in Jin there were Pei Kai and Zhang Hua.

units.zh: 左衛將軍徐世譜為護軍將軍，南兗州刺史吳明徹進號安南將軍，衡州刺史歐陽頠進號鎮南將軍。
units.en: Xu Shipu, left guard general, became general who protects the army; Wu Mingche, South Yanzhou inspector, was promoted to general who pacifies the south; Ouyang Wei, Hengzhou inspector, was promoted to general who garrisons the south.
units.literal: Left Guard General Xu Shipu became General Who Protects the Army; South Yanzhou Inspector Wu Mingche advanced in title to General Who Pacifies the South; Hengzhou Inspector Ouyang Wei advanced in title to General Who Pacifies the South.

units.zh: 二年春正月乙未，詔曰：「夫設官分職，因事重輕，羽儀車馬，隨時隆替，晉之五校，鳴笳啟途，漢之九卿，傳呼並迾，虞官夏禮，豈曰同科，殷朴周文，固無恆格。
units.en: In spring of the second year, on yiwei day of the first month, an edict declared: "Offices and duties are weighed by the business at hand; ceremonial escorts rise and fall with the age. Jin's Five Commandants sounded the reed-pipe to clear the road; Han's nine ministers had heralds cry out as they passed—Yu and Xia rites were not one model; Yin austerity and Zhou ornament had no fixed pattern.
units.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on yiwei day, an edict said: "Setting offices and dividing duties follows the weight of affairs; feathered banners and chariots and horses rise and fall with the times. Jin's Five Commandants sounded the reed-whistle to open the road; Han's Nine Ministers had runners call out together as they passed—rites of Yu and Xia, how could they be one standard? Yin simplicity and Zhou pattern surely have no fixed rule.

units.zh: 及隋師濟江，元帥清河公楊素下自巴硤，慧紀遣其將呂忠肅、陸倫等拒之，[4]戰敗，素進據馬頭。
units.en: When Sui forces crossed the Yangzi, the commander-in-chief, Duke of Qinghe Yang Su, came down from Baxia; Huiji sent his generals Lü Zhongsu, Lu Lun, and others to oppose them,[4] but they were defeated and Su advanced to seize Matou.
units.literal: When the Sui army crossed the Yangzi, the commander-in-chief, the Duke of Qinghe Yang Su, descended from Baxia; Huiji sent his generals Lü Zhongsu, Lu Lun, and others to resist them;[4] they were defeated in battle, and Su advanced and seized Matou.

units.zh: 從子持節、員外散騎常侍、明威將軍、雍州刺史、監南徐州擬，持節、通直散騎侍郎、貞威將軍、北徐州刺史褒，從子晃、炅，從孫假節、員外散騎常侍、明威將軍訬，假節、信威將軍、北徐州刺史吉陽縣開國侯諠，假節、通直散騎侍郎、信武將軍祏，[1]假節、散騎侍郎、雄信將軍、青州刺史、廣梁太守詳，貞威將軍、通直散騎侍郎慧紀，從孫敬雅、敬泰，並枝戚密近，劬勞王室，宜列河山，以光利建。
units.en: His nephew Ni, holder of the staff, supernumerary attendant-in-ordinary of the scattered cavalry, general of illustrious prestige, prefect of Yongzhou, and supervisor of Southern Xuzhou; Bao, holder of the staff, palace gentleman of regular attendance of the scattered cavalry, general of upright prestige, and prefect of Northern Xuzhou; the nephews Huang and Jiong; the great-nephew Xu, acting holder of the staff, supernumerary attendant-in-ordinary of the scattered cavalry, and general of illustrious prestige; Xuan, acting holder of the staff, general of trustworthy prestige, prefect of Northern Xuzhou, and marquis of Jiyang county; Zhi, acting holder of the staff, palace gentleman of regular attendance of the scattered cavalry, and general of trustworthy martiality;[1] Xiang, acting holder of the staff, palace gentleman of the scattered cavalry, general of majestic trust, prefect of Qingzhou, and administrator of Guangliang; Huiji, general of upright prestige and palace gentleman of regular attendance of the scattered cavalry; and the great-nephews Jingya and Jingtai—all close collateral kin who have labored for the royal house—should be granted domains upon the rivers and mountains to honor the founding of the dynasty.
units.literal: The Founder's nephew, Holder of the Staff, Supernumerary Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Scattered Cavalry, General of Illustrious Prestige, Prefect of Yongzhou, and Supervisor of Southern Xuzhou, Ni; the Holder of the Staff, Palace Gentleman of Regular Attendance of the Scattered Cavalry, General of Upright Prestige, and Prefect of Northern Xuzhou, Bao; the nephews Huang and Jiong; the great-nephew, Acting Holder of the Staff, Supernumerary Attendant-in-Ordinary of the Scattered Cavalry, and General of Illustrious Prestige, Xu; the Acting Holder of the Staff, General of Trustworthy Prestige, Prefect of Northern Xuzhou, and Marquis of Jiyang County, Xuan; the Acting Holder of the Staff, Palace Gentleman of Regular Attendance of the Scattered Cavalry, and General of Trustworthy Martiality, Zhi;[1] the Acting Holder of the Staff, Palace Gentleman of the Scattered Cavalry, General of Majestic Trust, Prefect of Qingzhou, and Administrator of Guangliang, Xiang; General of Upright Prestige and Palace Gentleman of Regular Attendance of the Scattered Cavalry, Huiji; and the great-nephews Jingya and Jingtai—all collateral kin of close degree who have toiled for the royal house—ought to be arrayed among the rivers and mountains to brighten the founding of the state.

units.zh: 是時，隋將韓擒虎及賀若弼等已濟江據蔣山，慧紀聞之，留其長史陳文盛等居守，身率將士三萬人，樓船千餘乘，沿江而下，欲趣臺城。
units.en: By then Sui generals Han Qihu, He Ruobi, and others had already crossed the river and seized Jiangshan. On hearing this, Huiji left his chief clerk Chen Wensheng and others to hold his post and personally led thirty thousand troops in more than a thousand tower ships downriver, intending to reach Taicheng.
units.literal: At this time the Sui generals Han Qihu and He Ruobi and others had already crossed the river and seized Jiangshan; when Huiji heard of it, he left his Chief Clerk Chen Wensheng and others to hold the defense and personally led thirty thousand officers and soldiers in more than a thousand tower ships downstream, intending to hurry to Taicheng.

units.zh: 至漢口，為秦王軍所拒，不得進，因與湘州刺史晉熙王叔文、巴州刺史畢寶等請降。
units.en: At Hankou he was blocked by the army of the Prince of Qin and could not advance; he therefore joined Shuwen, prince of Jinxi and prefect of Xiangzhou, Bi Bao, prefect of Bazhou, and others in offering surrender.
units.literal: Reaching Hankou, he was blocked by the Prince of Qin's army and could not advance; he therefore joined the Prefect of Xiangzhou, the Prince of Jinxi Xiao Shuwen, the Prefect of Bazhou Bi Bao, and others in requesting surrender.

units.zh: 王出鎮京口，勱將隨之藩，范陽張纘時典選舉，勱造纘言別，纘嘉其風采，乃曰：「王生才地，豈可游外府乎？」
units.en: When the prince went out to hold Jiangkou, Mo was to accompany him to the fief; Zhang Zuan of Fanyang then controlled appointments. Mo came to take leave of him, and Zuan, struck by his bearing, said, "A man of your talent and station—how can he be left to wander in an outer princely house?"
units.literal: When the prince went out to hold Jiangkou, Mo was about to follow to the principality; Zhang Zuan of Fanyang then held selection offices; Mo went to bid Zuan farewell; Zuan admired his presence and said: "Master Wang's talent and standing—how can he wander in an outer princely house?"

units.zh: 沈約一代詞宗，深所推挹。
units.en: Shen Yue, master of the age's words, prized him deeply.
units.literal: Shen Yue, master of a generation's words, deeply esteemed him.

units.zh: 旣至無衣，鎮軍將軍沈約遣裙衫迎之。
units.en: On arrival he had no clothes; Shen Yue the suppressing-army general sent skirt and robe to meet him.
units.literal: On arrival he had no clothes; Suppressing Army General Shen Yue sent skirt and robe to meet him.

units.zh: 昉卒後，高祖使學士賀縱共沈約勘其書目，官所無者，就昉家取之。
units.en: After Fang died, Gaozu had Academician He Zong and Shen Yue collate his catalog—what the office lacked, they took from Fang's house.
units.literal: After Fang died, Gaozu had Academician He Zong together with Shen Yue collate his book catalog—what the office lacked, they took from Fang's house.

units.zh: 是月，王琳爲陳所敗，蕭莊自拔至和州。
units.en: That month Wang Lin was defeated by Chen forces, and Xiao Zhuang fled on his own to Hezhou.
units.literal: That month Wang Lin was defeated by Chen; Xiao Zhuang escaped on his own to Hezhou.

units.zh: 第十二子瑒，別有傳。
units.en: The twelfth son, Yang, has a separate biography.
units.literal: The twelfth son Yang has a separate biography.

units.zh: 法和旣平約，往進見王僧辯於巴陵，謂曰：「貧道已斷侯景一臂，其更何能為，檀越宜卽遂取。」
units.en: After Fahe had pacified Yue, he went forward to see Wang Sengbian at Baling and said, "This humble monk has already cut off one arm of Hou Jing—what more can he do? My patron should press the attack at once."
units.literal: After Fahe had pacified Yue, he went forward to see Wang Sengbian at Baling and said: "This humble monk has already cut off one arm of Hou Jing—what more can he do? My patron should press the attack at once."

units.zh: 于時濟陽江總、吳國顧野王、陸瓊、從弟瑜、河南褚玠、北地傅縡等，皆以才學之美，晨夕娛侍。
units.en: At that time Jiang Zong of Jiyang, Gu Yewang of Wu, Lu Qiong, his cousin Yu, Chu Jie of Henan, Fu Zai of Beidi, and others, all famed for learning, served the heir morning and evening as literary companions.
units.literal: At that time Jiang Zong of Jiyang, Gu Yewang of Wu, Lu Qiong, his cousin Yu, Chu Jie of Henan, Fu Zai of Beidi, and others, all distinguished for literary talent, served morning and evening as companions.

units.zh: 又數令共野王遞相策問，恆蒙賞激。
units.en: He was often ordered to question Gu Yewang in turn and always won praise and rewards.
units.literal: He was repeatedly ordered to debate in turn with Gu Yewang and always won reward and praise.

units.zh: 高宗崩，始興王叔陵為亂，後主賴后與樂安君吳氏救而獲免，事在叔陵傳。
units.en: When Emperor Xuan died, Prince Shuling of Shixing rebelled. The Last Emperor escaped only because the empress and Lady Wu of Le'an rescued him; the affair is told in Shuling's biography.
units.literal: When Emperor Xuan died, Prince Shuling of Shixing made disorder; the Last Emperor escaped only through rescue by the empress and Lady Wu of Le'an. The affair is in Shuling's biography.

units.zh: 當是之時，新失淮南之地，隋師臨江，又國遭大喪，後主病瘡不能聽政，其誅叔陵、供大行喪事、邊境防守及百司红務，雖假以後主之命，實皆決之於后。
units.en: At the time Huainan had just been lost, Sui forces were on the Yangzi, and the state was in mourning. The Last Emperor was ill with sores and could not hear government, so the execution of Shuling, the late emperor's funeral, frontier defense, and all the business of the offices were formally done in the Last Emperor's name but in fact decided by the empress.
units.literal: At this time the Huainan lands had newly been lost, the Sui army stood on the Yangzi, and the state had suffered a great mourning; the Last Emperor was ill with sores and could not hear government, so the execution of Shuling, the funeral affairs for the deceased ruler, frontier defenses, and the many offices of government, though carried out in the Last Emperor's name, were all in fact decided by the empress.

units.zh: 史臣侍中鄭國公魏徵考覽記書，參詳故老，云後主初即位，以始興王叔陵之亂，被傷臥于承香閣下，時諸姬嵭不得進，唯張貴妃侍焉。
units.en: The historiographer, palace attendant and Duke of Zheng, Wei Zheng, examined the records and consulted elders and wrote: When the Last Emperor first succeeded, he was wounded in the disorder of Prince of Shixing Shuling and lay ill below the Hall of Accepting Fragrance; none of the palace women could enter—only Noble Consort Zhang attended him.
units.literal: The historiographer, Palace Attendant and Duke of Zheng, Wei Zheng, examined records and consulted elders, saying: When the Last Emperor first took the throne, because of the disorder of Prince of Shixing Shuling, he was wounded and lay ill below the Hall of Accepting Fragrance; at that time none of the ladies could enter—only Noble Consort Zhang attended him.

units.zh: 溉，〔一〕時梁州刺史陰子春、領軍朱异在焉。
units.en: Collation variant: (Gai), [1] At that time Liang inspector of Liangzhou Yin Zichun and director of the palace guard Zhu Yi were present.
units.literal: Collation variant: (Gai), At that time Liang Inspector of Liangzhou Yin Zichun and Director of the Palace Guard Zhu Yi were present.

units.zh: 子春素知申，即於坐所呼與為對，〔二〕申每有妙思，异觀而奇之，因引申遊處。
units.en: Zichun had long known Shen and immediately at the gathering called him to play a match, [2] Shen had fine conceptions each time; Yi watched and marveled, and thereafter drew Shen into his company.
units.literal: Zichun had long known Shen and immediately at the gathering called him to play a match, Shen had fine conceptions each time; Yi watched and marveled, and thereafter drew Shen into his company.

units.zh: 幼沈靜，寡嗜欲，受業于周弘正，善三玄，精於論議，聲擅都邑。
units.en: From youth he was quiet and reserved, with few desires; he studied under Zhou Hongzheng, was skilled in the Three Mysteries, excelled in disputation, and his fame filled the capital.
units.literal: From youth he was quiet and reserved, with few desires; he studied under Zhou Hongzheng, was skilled in the Three Mysteries, excelled in disputation, and his fame filled the capital.

units.zh: 文帝嗣位，解少傅，加特進、左光祿大夫。
units.en: When Emperor Wen succeeded, he was relieved as junior tutor and given supernumerary privilege together with the left grand master of the golden sigil.
units.literal: When Emperor Wen succeeded, he was relieved as Junior Tutor and given Supernumerary Privilege and Left Grand Master of the Golden Sigil.

units.zh: 文帝即位，益加尊重，嘗從文帝幸司空徐度宅，宴筵之上，賜以几。
units.en: When Emperor Wen succeeded, the honor grew; once, accompanying the emperor to Minister of Works Xu Du's house, he was given an armrest at the banquet.
units.literal: When Emperor Wen took the throne, respect increased; once he followed Emperor Wen on a visit to Minister of Works Xu Du's residence, and at the banquet the Emperor gave him an armrest.

units.zh: 文帝嗣位，領太子少傅。
units.en: When Emperor Wen succeeded, he headed tutor to the heir apparent.
units.literal: When Emperor Wen succeeded, he headed Tutor to the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 初，廣州刺史馬靖久居嶺表，大得人心，士馬彊盛，朝廷疑之。
units.en: Ma Jing had long governed Guangzhou in the far south, won the people's loyalty, and commanded a strong force; the court grew wary of him.
units.literal: Earlier, Ma Jing, Inspector of Guangzhou, had long dwelt south of the ranges, won great favor among the people, and had strong troops and horses; the court was suspicious of him.

units.zh: 至是以方慶為仁威將軍、廣州刺史，以兵襲靖。
units.en: Fangqing was then made general of benevolent might and inspector of Guangzhou and sent to attack Ma Jing with an army.
units.literal: Thereupon Fangqing was made General of Benevolent Might and Inspector of Guangzhou and sent with troops to attack Jing.

units.zh: 靖誅，進號宣毅將軍。
units.en: After Jing was killed, Fangqing was promoted to general who proclaims resolution.
units.literal: When Jing was executed, Fangqing was advanced in title to General Who Proclaims Resolution.

units.zh: 靖誅，以功封龍陽縣子。
units.en: After Jing's death Yong was enfeoffed as viscount of Longyang for his service.
units.literal: When Jing was executed, Yong was enfeoffed as Viscount of Longyang county for merit.

units.zh: 至德二年，進號智武將軍、武州刺史。
units.en: In Zhide year two he was promoted to general of intelligent martial might and inspector of Wuzhou.
units.literal: In the second year of Zhide he was advanced in title to General of Intelligent Martial Might and Inspector of Wuzhou.

units.zh: 方慶之襲馬靖也，朝廷以勇為超武將軍、東衡州刺史，領始興內史，以為方慶聲勢。
units.en: When Fangqing moved against Ma Jing, the court made Yong super martial general, inspector of Eastern Hengzhou, and interior magistrate of Shixing to strengthen Fangqing's position.
units.literal: When Fangqing attacked Ma Jing, the court made Yong Super Martial General, Inspector of Eastern Hengzhou, and concurrent Interior Magistrate of Shixing, to lend weight to Fangqing's campaign.

units.zh: 與懷朔省事雲中司馬子如及秀容人劉貴、中山人賈顯智為奔走之友，懷朔戶曹史孫騰、外兵史侯景亦相友結。
units.en: He made running companions of Sima Ziru, affairs clerk at Huaishuo's Yunzhong desk, Liu Gui of Xiurong, and Jia Xianzhi of Zhongshan; Sun Teng, the garrison household clerk, and Hou Jing, clerk for external military affairs, joined their circle as well.
units.literal: With Sima Ziru, affairs clerk of Yunzhong at Huaishuo, Liu Gui of Xiurong, and Jia Xianzhi of Zhongshan he formed a band of comrades ready to run errands; Sun Teng, household clerk at Huaishuo, and Hou Jing, clerk in external military affairs, also joined in friendship.
